items.title: Start Here
items.content:
Welcome to Getting Started with HAX

This short course takes about 15 minutes. By the end you’ll know how to move around a HAX site, edit a page, and add your own content.

What you’ll be able to do

  • Find any page using the site menu
  • Turn on editing and change text on a page
  • Add a block, such as an image or a video
  • Save your work

How this course works

  1. Lesson 1 introduces the editor.
  2. Each page builds on the one before, so go in order.
  3. Finish with a short self-check. It isn’t graded.

You can’t break anything here. Try every button you see.

items.title: Lesson 1: Finding Your Way Around HAX
items.content:
Lesson 1 Overview

HAX sites look like ordinary websites until you sign in. Then a bar at the top gives you tools to edit pages, add pages, and change the whole site. This lesson walks through those tools.

In this lesson

  • Reading a HAX Site
  • Editing a Page
  • Check Your Understanding

items.title: Reading a HAX Site
items.content:
Every HAX site is a set of pages arranged in an outline. Pages can sit under other pages, the way this page sits under Lesson 1.

Look around

  • Site menu: lists every page. Pages under another page are nested below it.
  • Page title: the large heading at the top tells you where you are.
  • Links in the text: take you to other pages in the site, like the ones in the Lesson 1 overview.

Did you know? A HAX site is plain files: one site.json outline plus a folder of pages. You can copy it, publish it anywhere, and it keeps working.

items.title: Editing a Page
items.content:
Once you’re signed in, the bar at the top of the page has everything you need. Follow these steps on this page.

Try it

  1. Select Edit in the top bar. The page becomes editable.
  2. Click any paragraph and type. Text works like a word processor.
  3. Click a block, then Configure to change its settings, such as an image’s size or a heading’s style.
  4. Open Blocks to add something new: images, videos, tables, quizzes and more. You can also type / on an empty line to search for a block.
  5. Select Save. Your changes are live.

Shortcuts worth knowing

Press Alt + Shift (Cmd + Shift in Safari) to open Merlin, the HAX command search. Type what you want, like “add page” or “image”, and pick from the list.

Use Add page in the top bar for a new page next to this one. Open Outline to drag pages into a new order or nest them under each other.

Open Site Settings and choose Appearance to switch the theme, colors and regions.

Leaving a page with unsaved edits asks whether to discard them. Save before you move on.

items.title: Check Your Understanding
items.content:
Two quick questions to make sure the big ideas stuck. They aren’t graded.

You changed three paragraphs and added a table. What do you do before going to another page?

Select Save in the top bar. Unsaved edits are lost if you leave and choose to discard them.

Reflect

What’s one page you’d like to build first? Add it now with Add page, then edit it using what you just learned.

You finished the orientation. You’re ready to build your own course.
